A01.name: Future leakage through sector assignment
A01.rationale: Sector labels are PIT_SAFE_WITH_LAG, not vintage-correct. Possible look-ahead for GICS reclassifications.

A02.name: Future leakage through macro alignment
A02.rationale: Macro data is PIT_NATIVE, published same day.

A03.name: Incorrect macro release timing
A03.rationale: FRED data published at 16:30 ET, available before next trading day.

A04.name: Interaction feature leakage
A04.rationale: Interaction features are products of current PIT-safe values.

A05.name: Sector survivorship bias
A05.rationale: Instruments from universe files, not survivorship-filtered.

A06.name: Sector membership drift
A06.rationale: Current sector labels used. No historical GICS vintage available.

A07.name: Baseline weakening
A07.rationale: Baseline uses genuine price-derived features with non-zero variance.

A09.name: Horizon overlap errors
A09.rationale: Forward returns computed with proper lag.

A10.name: Duplicate experiments
A10.rationale: All 20 experiments have unique (horizon, macro, rep, universe) keys.

A13.name: Sector sample imbalance
A13.rationale: S55 has 1 instrument. Small sectors may have insufficient data.

A14.name: Single-sector concentration
A14.rationale: S35 has 13 instruments (26%). Effect may be concentrated.

A17.name: Model fishing
A17.rationale: Only Ridge used. No model comparison.
